high_level_description: This image captures a serene urban street scene on a clear, sunny day with a few scattered clouds in the sky. The focal point of the image is a tall tree that has been pruned into an artistic, almost sculptural form. The tree's branches have been shaped to resemble a series of vertical columns or pillars, creating a striking visual effect against the backdrop of the sky. The tree is situated between two rows of residential buildings. On the left side, there are several multi-story brick buildings with white window frames and chimneys, typical of traditional urban architecture.
